purpose: Explains test count differences across P1.25/P1.26/P1.27 and why P1.26's 'pre-existing failures' were actually environment configuration errors

p125.note: P1.25 excluded ~400 tests with '--ignore=tests/fundamental' and excluded failing tests as 'pre-existing'. pytest-asyncio was 1.4.0 (too old).

p126.note: P1.26 added P1.26 test suite but still excluded 'pre-existing' failures. FastAPI 0.116.1 caused 23 additional failures in test_phase6m/test_phase6l.

p127.note: P1.27 fixed all environment issues. True canonical run with no exclusions except known pytest skips.
7105 includes P1.27 targeted suite (79 pass + 53 skip for pending soak windows)

pytest_asyncio.symptom: 830 async test functions reported as 'not natively supported' — skipped/failed

fastapi.symptom: 23 tests failed: 'AssertionError: Status code 204 must not have a response body'

missing_packages.issue: pypdf, baostock, alembic not installed in Python 3.11.8 test env.
missing_packages.symptom: ModuleNotFoundError during collection; test files not collected
missing_packages.fix: python3.11 -m pip install pypdf baostock alembic

missing_init_py.issue: tests/__init__.py missing; tj1 files import 'from tests.fundamental.phase6tj1_helpers'

p127_skip_analysis.skip_reason: Tests marked pytest.mark.skip in tj1 files — require live PostgreSQL/Redis connections not available in unit test environment
p127_skip_analysis.skip_legitimacy: legitimate — DB-connected tests belong in integration suite

net_new_in_p127.coverage: Y1-Y10 soak windows, browser E2E 30 cases, rollback drill, gate evaluation A-Q
